Doc ‘Stack App’ vs product ‘stack’ on app-type control may warn. Rest: Custom Hosting, two JSON Custom Fields (/product-field, /category-field), Entry Sidebar (/sidebar-widget), App Configuration (/config). **Product:** after footer Save on a location configurator, **Go back** may be required to reach the listing before the next ⋯ step (doc may compress this). **Automation:** if the org hits the Developer Hub *maximum app creation* limit, the runner opens the first existing Stack App and skips *Create Standard App* modal steps — that app may already have UI Locations from older runs; for a clean doc match, free a slot (delete apps) or raise the limit so a **new** app can be created. Icon upload omitted. npm/API out of scope. Optional Install/OAuth.
